source: Real workflow bug: BLOCKED reviews are currently stored as running, obscuring a blocked task
goal: Persist review verdict BLOCKED as task state blocked. Reject renew/submit/execute for blocked tasks until explicit recover --stopped. Recover must accept blocked and create a new attempt on next claim. Preserve review evidence in history. Keep ISSUES -> running and PASS -> approved unchanged.
non_goals: Do not change cryptography, dependencies, runtime runner, gates, permissions or Git history. Do not commit. Do not invoke agentctl against the real database.
acceptance: Add meaningful real Git/SQLite regression tests for BLOCKED state, rejected renew/submit, explicit stopped recovery, new attempt/token, and unchanged ISSUES/PASS behavior.
Run python3 scripts/test_agentctl.py and report results; coordinator runs full gate.
Update owning coordination contract and relevant user instructions to reflect blocked state.
